name: EPIC 201589658
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 5.9 solar radii and 0.88 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201589658 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 5.87872 (16th-84th percentiles 5.641082-6.139344), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201589658 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.876336 (16th-84th percentiles 0.787434-0.980106), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201589658: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 5441.045 +/- 233 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201589658 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2777.265625 (16th-84th percentiles 2683.710938-2875), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.08 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,777 parsecs away, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.88 solar masses and 5.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,441 K at its surface.
